_about: Public-domain William Le Roy Stidger (1885-1949), Methodist preacher and later professor of homiletics at Boston University, for the Word Hoard: his books printed before 1930, among them Giant Hours with Poet Preachers, Soldier Silhouettes on our Front, Star Dust from the Dugouts, Outdoor Men and Minds, Flash-Lights from the Seven Seas, Standing Room Only, There are Sermons in Books, The Place of Books in the Life we Live, Flames of Faith, Henry Ford, Symphonic Sermons, That God's House may be Filled, Finding God in Books, Building up the Mid-Week Service, Building Sermons with Symphonic Themes, Pulpit Prayers and Paragraphs, God is at the Organ, The High Faith of Fiction and Drama, and Preaching out of the Overflow. He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 116 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
